name: MiniMed Group, Inc.
summary: MiniMed Group, Inc. operates as a medical technology company that develops, manufactures, and markets medical equipment for the management of diabetes. The company offers technologies including insulin delivery devices, such as insulin pumps and pens, continuous glucose monitors, other consumables, supplies, and related software and services. It serves people with diabetes who require insulin therapy, which represents all people with T1D and a subset of those with T2D.
